title: The Vision Quest
description: Trace computer vision from the Neocognitron through AlexNet's deep learning revolution to the generative explosion of DALL-E and Stable Diffusion. Seeing became creating.
targetAudience: Visual artists and those interested in AI image generation
keyTakeaways: CNNs learn hierarchical visual features automatically
ImageNet provided the dataset that proved deep learning
GANs enabled generation through adversarial training
Diffusion models surpassed GANs for image quality and diversity
